content:
maya: heads up — scope reckoning for milestone Q2. customer Acme pushed tenant embeddings cache + SSO. timeline is tight, we need a firm call on mvp vs v1 by EOD Friday.

devin: short answer: we can deliver a "minimum cache" for reads + simple TTL in 2 sprints if we cut prewarm + per-tenant warm paths. write path (sync) is more expensive.

arjun: infra risk: multi-tenant cache + eviction policy will add memory pressure on dedicated pools. if we rush we risk OOM spikes. prefer deferring writes to v1.

sam: product/metrics POV — if we defer cache writes, we must add telemetry hooks to measure cold-start QPS and customer IO patterns. need clear acceptance criteria for mvp.

liz: propose acceptance checklist for MVP: 1) read-only embeddings cache with per-tenant namespace and 24h TTL, 2) telemetry: cache hit/miss + tail latency per tenant, 3) fallback to origin model on miss, 4) doc + runbook for rollback.

maya: +1 on liz checklist. also need gating on customer success signoff (Acme) and a performance SLO: p95 < 200ms for cached prompts.

devin: implementation plan sketch:
```
- cache service (rust) behind router
- edge lookup: prefer KV, fall back to sync generation
- background prewarm job (optional)
```
If we disable prewarm for MVP we save ~2 weeks on infra hardening.

arjun: also call out operational cost: extra GPU memory for cached vectors; we should include cost estimate in PR.

sam: question — can we ship a lightweight canary to 5 customers (incl Acme) and gate on cache hit rate > 25% and no P95 regressions before broad rollout?

liz: yes. canary + feature flag. if canary passes, roll 20% -> 50% -> 100%. fallback toggle required.

maya: trade-offs doc: ship read-only cache in MVP, defer write API + prewarm + cross-tenant compaction to v1. we need to update launch criteria and timeline.

devin: timeline impact: removing writes saves ~3 sprints of backend work, moves us back on schedule to target launch date.

arjun: request for engineering: add memory eviction metric + circuit-breaker on cache misses to prevent amplification.

sam: also need evals: run prompt set with cached vs uncached to measure quality delta and ensure identical outputs when fallback occurs.

maya: action items:
- devin: draft implementation PR + cost estimate by Tue
- arjun: add eviction + memory alarms to infra board by Wed
- sam: prepare eval prompt set + telemetry dashboard by Wed
- liz: update launch criteria doc and customer comms draft by Thu

deploy-bot: PR opened -> refs: github.com/redwood/cache/mvp-readonly (devin) :rocket:

devin: tagging @maya @liz — PR includes a toggleable feature flag and a canary rollout plan. linking rough graph for rollout cadence.

maya: this is good. if canary shows >25% hit and no perf regression we call this MVP done. otherwise we delay and trigger contingency plan (disable flag + customer notification).

liz: adding notes for release: update support runbook and add FAQ for customers about "why cache sometimes misses".

arjun: one more ops note: add a temporary quota per tenant to limit worst-case memory usage during canary.

sam: sounds like consensus. i'll schedule a short sync Friday to approve final acceptance criteria.

maya: thanks everyone — will follow up with a consolidated decision doc after Friday's sync. :thumbsup:
